gloss: to be utterly dumbfounded; to be completely appalled

definitions.gloss: to be utterly dumbfounded; to be completely appalled
definitions.explanation: An intensified form of {呆|あき}れる, expressing extreme exasperation or disbelief at someone's behavior or a situation.

examples.japanese: ⟦もう→もう：00602_mou⟧{呆|あき}れ{返|かえ}った⟦よ→よ：09475_yo⟧。
⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{発言|はつげん}→発言：05099_hatsugen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{呆|あき}れ{返|かえ}ってしまった。
examples.english: I was utterly appalled by that remark.

examples.japanese: ⟦{何度|なんど}→何度：17592_nando⟧⟦{注意|ちゅうい}→注意：01464_chuui⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{直|なお}らない→直る：00735_naoru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{周|まわ}り→周り：01732_mawari⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{呆|あき}れ{返|かえ}って⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: No matter how many times he's warned, he doesn't change, so everyone around him is completely exasperated.

notes:
A compound verb formed from ⟦{呆|あき}れる→呆れる：06720_akireru⟧ (to be amazed/appalled) + ⟦{返|かえ}る→返る：29164_kaeru⟧ (to return). The ⟦{返|かえ}る→返る：29164_kaeru⟧ suffix intensifies the base verb, giving a sense of being so shocked that one is left speechless or unable to react. Always carries a negative connotation — expressing disgust, exasperation, or disbelief rather than positive surprise.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {呆|あき}れ{返|かえ}って⟦{物|もの}→物：02259_mono⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{言|い}えない→言う：00515_iu⟧: so appalled one can't even speak
- {呆|あき}れ{返|かえ}った⟦{顔|かお}→顔：00558_kao⟧: a look of utter disbelief
- {呆|あき}れ{返|かえ}ってしまう: to end up completely dumbfounded

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{呆|あき}れる→呆れる：06720_akireru⟧: to be amazed, appalled — the base form; less intense
- ⟦{唖然|あぜん}→唖然：09404_azen⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to be stunned — focuses on speechlessness from shock
- {開|あき}いた⟦{口|くち}→口：00560_kuchi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{塞|ふさ}がらない→塞がる：14872_fusagaru⟧: to be left open-mouthed — an idiom expressing extreme shock or disbelief

COMMON PATTERNS:
The ～⟦{返|かえ}る→返る：29164_kaeru⟧ pattern is a productive compound verb suffix meaning "to do something to an extreme degree" or "all the way back." Other examples include ⟦{繰|く}り{返|かえ}す→繰り返す：02051_kurikaesu⟧ (to repeat) and ⟦{振|ふ}り{返|かえ}る→振り返る：04231_furikaeru⟧ (to look back).
